scientific_role: Diagnose whether party-specific forecast-error marginals are temporally transportable before constructing any joint 2026 uncertainty law.
crossfit: Fit residual marginals on 2011_TO_2016 and evaluate on 2016_TO_2021.
Fit residual marginals on 2016_TO_2021 and evaluate on 2011_TO_2016.

candidate_families.definition: For each party, estimate signed residual quantiles of next_share - prior_share on the training transition. Add the 10/90 and 2.5/97.5 percentiles to the held-out prior share and clip to [0,1].
For each party, estimate 80% and 95% quantiles of abs(next_share-prior_share) on the training transition and use symmetric intervals around the held-out persistence mean, clipped to [0,1].

For each party, estimate signed residual quantiles of logit(next_share)-logit(prior_share), apply them to the held-out prior logit, then map interval endpoints back to actual share space. Coverage is always evaluated in actual shares.

quantile_method: numpy linear empirical quantile on exactly 92 training territories per party; no post-hoc widening.
selection: Eligibility requires every one of 9 parties to clear both coverage floors in both held-out transitions.
Among eligible families choose lowest mean absolute calibration error across party x transition x {80,95}.
Then choose lower mean 95% interval width.
Then deterministic family order as listed above.

interpretation.PASS: At least one marginal family transfers by party in both directions. Proceed to a separate frozen shared-dependence/copula construction for joint seat simulation.
interpretation.FAIL: No party-marginal error law is temporally transportable under these nonparametric families. Do not widen globally and do not reopen E_reason; move to a regime/scenario envelope with explicit non-stationarity.

forbidden: Tune quantiles after seeing held-out coverage
Drop a difficult party from the gate
Use centered-logit RMSE as a substitute for actual-share coverage
